s.Folders with VIDEO_TS or BDMV. Convertin: Folders with VIDEO_TS or BDMV. Converting turns them into one .mkv with all video, audio, subtitles and chapters.
s.Converting copies everything 1:1 into on: Converting copies everything 1:1 into one .mkv: video (HDR too), all audio tracks, subtitles and chapters. For a DVD it picks the longest title (the film). The old folder goes to quarantine, so you can restore it. The .mkv then goes through normal encoding and subtitles. Dolby Vision Blu-rays become Dolby Vision profile 8.1 (base layer 1:1, DV metadata added): Plex and your TV play it as Dolby Vision, other players as HDR10. Such a film is not re-encoded afterwards, since that would lose Dolby Vision.

s.MediaScan makes your movies and shows sm: MediaScan makes your movies and shows smaller without a visible difference, and fills in missing subtitles. Originals are only replaced after a quality check, and are first kept in quarantine for a while.
s.Six short steps and you're set up. You c: Six short steps and you're set up. You can change everything later in Settings.
s.MediaScan is now looking for videos in y: MediaScan is now looking for videos in your media folder. With a large library the first scan takes a while; you can simply carry on.
s.Folders MediaScan never touches, separat: Folders MediaScan never touches, separated by commas (e.g. Music, Downloads).
s.Choose the languages every file should h: Choose the languages every file should have. MediaScan looks for missing ones on OpenSubtitles. If that fails, the worker makes the subtitle itself (speech recognition and translation on your own PC).
Click a language to remove it.
s.Every movie is measured with VMAF, a sco: Every movie is measured with VMAF, a score for how the picture looks to the human eye. "High" is indistinguishable from the original for almost everyone.
s.Higher = better picture, less space save: Higher = better picture, less space saved.
A safety net for grain and dark scenes. 5 Mbps is a good default; 4K and other resolutions scale accordingly.
s.With Plex connected, MediaScan waits to: With Plex connected, MediaScan waits to replace a movie while someone is watching it, and refreshes Plex after every change. No Plex? Just skip this step.
s.The heavy lifting happens on a PC or Mac: The heavy lifting happens on a PC or Mac with a good graphics card: the worker. Install it now, or later via Workers. As long as there is no worker, nothing happens to your files.
s.Connect the media share on the new machi: Connect the media share on the new machine.
s.Windows: drive letter or \\\\NAS\\Media: Windows: drive letter or \\NAS\Media · Mac: Finder › Connect to Server · Linux: see the instructions in the package.
s.Download the package for that system and: Download the package for that system and unpack it.
s.The installer asks for the details below: The installer asks for the details below and tests the connection.
